$comment: Grandfathered violations of the SECURITY DEFINER convention — see
scripts/check-definer-grants.mjs. Everything listed here is ALREADY APPLIED to
production; the fix for each is a NEW migration, which is a schema change and
belongs to whoever owns the schema, not to the gate that found it.
The gate fails on anything NOT in this list. This file is the record of what
was true the day the gate was switched on, so that the gate could be switched
on at all instead of being disabled for shouting about history.
Entries are matched on signature + kind: the SAME function with a DIFFERENT
kind of violation still fails. Adding an entry here is a code-review decision
and should be rare — the list is meant to shrink and never to grow.

grandfathered.reason: Trigger function (returns trigger), first written in 0028 and revoked from PUBLIC only by 0041_security_perf_p0.sql:7. anon and authenticated therefore keep the EXECUTE that Supabase grants by default. NOT reachable by a browser role: PostgREST does not expose trigger-returning functions as /rpc/ endpoints, and firing a trigger does not consult EXECUTE (0120's precedent). This is exactly the class 0281 group (c) revoked from all three roles — bump_coupon_use was simply not on that list, which is the same drift 0284 documented. Fix is a one-line new migration: revoke all on function public.bump_coupon_use() from public, anon, authenticated;
